answer: The protocol requires each AI agent to reserve a 1-unit capacity slot in a secure gateway, acting as a falcon watching for any unauthorized occupancy drift. An honest participant pays for its singular, exclusive reservation; 1,000 fakes must incur immense, concurrent costs to maintain these slots, as persistent as a dune against the wind. A verifier audits logs with a digital quill, and any overlap triggers immediate, irreversible privilege revocation; no refunds exist.
